facts.business: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited is a Navratna public sector enterprise executing railway infrastructure projects and diversified into metros, highways, ports, power transmission, digital infrastructure (BharatNet), rolling stock manufacturing (Vande Bharat Sleeper), and renewable energy (solar) across India and overseas.

auditor.name: Gandhi Minocha & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Non-compliance with Companies Act 2013, SEBI LODR Regulations & DPE guidelines regarding Board composition (lack of requisite Independent Directors and Independent Woman Director), affecting Audit Committee, Nomination and Remuneration Committee, Stakeholders' Relationship Committee; inventory physical verification not conducted by management for one project; title/lease deeds of some immovable properties not in company's name (detailed in Appendix A).

key_risks: Dependence on government nominations for projects historically, now transitioning to competitive bidding
Non-compliance with corporate governance requirements (Board composition, Independent Directors)
Inventory verification gaps for specific projects
Title/lease deed discrepancies for immovable properties
Concentration risk in order book despite diversification
International execution risks across Middle East, Central Asia, East Africa, South Asia
facts.related_party_note: Loans to subsidiaries: Rs 49.59 crore granted during year, balance outstanding Rs 49.59 crore; Guarantees to subsidiaries: Rs 13.51 crore provided during year, balance outstanding Rs 35.30 crore; Guarantees to joint ventures: Rs 3.00 crore provided during year, balance outstanding Rs 19.52 crore; Investment in associate Kinet Railway Solutions Ltd: Rs 121.97 crore including fair value of financial guarantee Rs 19.24 crore; Guarantee outstanding for Kinet Railway Solutions Ltd: Rs 282.50 crore; Lease receivables from Ministry of Railways for IRFC-funded projects transferred to zonal railways.
